title: User Experience Questionnaire, short version
description: 8 bipolar word pairs rated on a 7-point scale (−3 to +3); pragmatic and hedonic quality.

citation.text: Schrepp M, Hinderks A, Thomaschewski J (2017). Design and evaluation of a short version of the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ-S). International Journal of Interactive Multimedia and Artificial Intelligence 4(6):103–108.

scoring.text: Means: pragmatic quality = items 1–4, hedonic quality = items 5–8, overall = all 8. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.

note: Enter each pair as `negative pole – positive pole` so that +3 is the positive pole.
